simple.prompt: She ___ a senior software consultant at an international firm.
simple.explanation: Subject 'She' (orang ketiga tunggal) berpasangan dengan to be 'is'.

simple.prompt: The team members ___ ready for the product demonstration.
simple.explanation: 'The team members' adalah subject jamak (plural/they), sehingga memakai to be 'are'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat deklaratif menggunakan to be yang tepat.
simple.targetSentence: I am responsible for customer support.
simple.explanation: Subject 'I' berpasangan dengan 'am', diikuti complement sifat 'responsible for customer support'.

simple.prompt: The weather in this coastal town ___ very pleasant in April.
simple.explanation: 'The weather' adalah uncountable noun (kata benda tak terhitung/tunggal), sehingga memakai 'is'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya sederhana menggunakan to be.
simple.targetSentence: Are you available for a quick meeting?
simple.explanation: Kalimat tanya untuk 'you': To be (Are) + Subject (you) + Adjective (available) + Prepositional phrase.

simple.prompt: Both my brother and my sister ___ working remotely today.
simple.explanation: Subjek majemuk yang dihubungkan dengan 'and' bernilai jamak (plural/they), jadi gunakan 'are'.
hints: Ada dua orang: brother dan sister.
Dua subjek digabung dengan 'and' bernilai jamak.

simple.targetSentence: This document is not the final version.
simple.explanation: Pola negatif: Subject (This document) + is + not + Noun phrase complement (the final version).

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di resepsionis kantor dengan to be yang sesuai.
dialogue: Excuse me, ___ Mr. Rahman in his office right now?
Yes, he is. Please have a seat for a moment.
intermediate.explanation: 'Mr. Rahman' adalah orang ketiga tunggal (he), sehingga pertanyaan memakai 'Is'.

intermediate.prompt: Neither the manager nor the supervisors ___ satisfied with the initial draft.
intermediate.explanation: Pada pola 'neither... nor...', to be menyesuaikan subjek terdekat yaitu 'the supervisors' (jamak), sehingga memakai 'are'.
hints: Perhatikan subjek yang paling dekat dengan to be ('supervisors').

intermediate.prompt: Neither the supervisors nor the manager ___ present at the hearing.
intermediate.explanation: Subjek terdekat dengan to be adalah 'the manager' (tunggal), maka to be yang tepat adalah 'is'.
hints: Subjek terdekat di sini adalah 'the manager' (tunggal).

intermediate.prompt: Susun respon tanya jawab singkat dengan to be.
intermediate.targetSentence: No they are not in the conference room.
intermediate.explanation: Respon negatif: No + subject pronoun (they) + are + not + prepositional phrase.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih jawaban singkat yang gramatikal dan alami.
dialogue: Are all project files updated on the shared drive?
intermediate.explanation: Jawaban singkat positif tidak boleh disingkat dengan apostrof (tidak boleh 'Yes, they're'). Harus lengkap: 'Yes, they are.'

intermediate.prompt: The committee ___ unanimous in its historic verdict.
intermediate.explanation: Collective noun 'committee' yang bertindak sebagai satu kesatuan utuh (terlihat dari pronoun 'its') memakai to be tunggal 'is'.
hints: Gunakan 'is' untuk collective noun sebagai satu entitas.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya inversi dengan kata tanya Wh-.
intermediate.targetSentence: Why are the server logs unavailable today?
intermediate.explanation: Wh-word (Why) + to be (are) + Subject (the server logs) + Adjective complement (unavailable) + Time (today).

complex.prompt: Perbaiki subject-verb agreement pada kalimat yang disisipi frasa preposisi.
complex.draft: The primary cause of these complex issues are lack of communication.
options: The primary cause of these complex issues is lack of communication.
The primary cause of these complex issues are the lack of communication.
The primary causes of this complex issue is lack of communication.
complex.explanation: Subjek utama kalimat adalah 'The primary cause' (tunggal), bukan 'issues'. Maka to be yang benar adalah 'is'.
hints: Abaikan frasa pengganggu 'of these complex issues'.

complex.prompt: A number of qualified candidates ___ being interviewed this afternoon.
complex.explanation: Frasa 'A number of' berarti 'sejumlah/banyak' dan selalu diikuti noun jamak serta kata kerja jamak 'are'.
hints: 'A number of' berbeda dengan 'The number of'.

complex.prompt: Sebaliknya: 'The number of applicants ___ increased substantially this quarter.'
complex.explanation: Frasa 'The number of' mengacu pada angka/jumlah spesifik (entitas tunggal), sehingga memakai 'has' atau 'is'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggunaan to be pada konstruksi sematan.
complex.draft: One of the most experienced directors are leading the new taskforce.
options: One of the most experienced directors is leading the new taskforce.
One of the most experienced directors are being leading the new taskforce.
One of the most experienced director is leading the new taskforce.
complex.explanation: Pola 'One of + plural noun' memiliki subjek inti 'One' (satu orang/tunggal), sehingga membutuhkan to be 'is'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal dengan klausa relatif dan to be.
complex.targetSentence: The data that is collected remains confidential.
complex.explanation: 'Data' di konteks modern teknologi sering diperlakukan sebagai singular mass noun: 'that is collected'.
hints: Gunakan klausa relatif 'that is collected' sebelum verb utama 'remains'.

complex.prompt: Pilih bentuk to be yang sesuai dengan subjek semu (dummy subject).
dialogue: What is the reason for this expenditure?
It ___ the additional consulting fees that caused the surge.
complex.explanation: Pada cleft sentence yang diawali dummy 'It', to be SELALU berbentuk tunggal ('It is' atau 'It was'), meskipun kata yang ditekankan jamak.
hints: Pada konstruksi 'It is/was...', subjek tata bahasa adalah 'It'.
'It' selalu berpasangan dengan to be tunggal.

complex.prompt: Koreksi to be pada kalimat dengan frasa 'as well as'.
complex.draft: The CEO, as well as her senior executives, are attending the summit.
options: The CEO, as well as her senior executives, is attending the summit.
The CEO, as well as her senior executives, are being attending the summit.
The CEO as well as her senior executives were both attending the summit.
complex.explanation: Frasa sisipan seperti 'as well as', 'together with', atau 'along with' tidak mengubah jumlah subjek utama ('The CEO' = tunggal), sehingga tetap memakai 'is'.
hints: Frasa 'as well as' adalah keterangan tambahan, bukan penggabung jamak 'and'.
